description: Is the wallet that paid you a real customer or an automated x402 scanner? Returns known_scanner_fleet | automated_checker | unclassified with evidence (fleet/group, description, first seen paying MoneyTools) from MoneyTools' curated list of Base payer wallets. Free preview: an unpaid call returns the 402 plus the verdict label (known-automated / indistinguishable); $0.005 full evidence. Free preview (verdict label only, 3/day per client) in the unpaid response; $0.005 full evidence via x402 (MCP params._meta["x402/payment"] or HTTP) or X-API-Key credits. Failed calls are not charged.
